corrections.why: Three sources date the tower's end to 1952, not 1950, and Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site Gone / Destroyed rather than abandoned.

notes_for_editor: Brief's 1950 abandoned is not supported: every source says gone in 1952. All sources are secondary lookout-history sites; no Forest Service record was found for this tower. Idaho Fire Lookouts has no staffing history. No source describes remains or public access; the only access fact is the hike-in tag.
